lede: Chiang Rai accounts for 333 catalogued manuscripts, 57 of them flagged research-priority. Nearly all (96%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (79%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (18%). Dated witnesses run 1733–2024 CE (192 of 333 carry a date).
